scope: Independent local health insights; not Athlytic proprietary algorithms
widget_code: Four opt-in WidgetKit configurations with App Group; separate profiles required

algorithms.activation: 15-minute median HR vs personal resting HR baseline; context only from imported sleep/workouts; not validated stress measurement
algorithms.monitor: One displayed source per metric; previous 28 days, >=14 observations, robust MAD band; no sickness prediction
algorithms.load: Session RPE, complete-day 7/28 means, gap-preserving history
algorithms.sleep: Specific phases preserved; observed REM+deep, awake intervals; user-configurable planning heuristic, not biological prediction

privacy.xml: on-device streaming; 10000 selected rows maximum; preview before save
privacy.widget_snapshot: opt-in, separate minimal protected summary; privacySensitive UI

compatibility: New optional preferences decode old archives; same app bundle ID and storage
verification: See generated VERIFICA-RELEASE.json in the artifact for the compiled commit, tests and IPA hash. Native UI outcome is a separate artifact.
phone_feedback: HRV/RHR and dedup confirmed on earlier build; Principale fix and new screens/XML/widget installation need phone test
